snippet.title: PROJEKT GODHAND 1.0 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play PROJEKT GODHAND (free demo available): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978440/PROJEKT_GODHAND/
ULTIMATE TOOL ASSISTED BULLSHITTING KEYBOARD DESTRUCTION RHYTHM GAME version 1.0 arrives on 2/28/26.

The greatest aura farming rhythm gaming experience arrives with 50+ songs included to demolish your keyboard and hands to! Cheat your way to fun and glory and save(?) the world from giant space animals by punching them back into space with legendary holy mecha fists.

VO: @ChairGTables
